notes.title: Introducing the voices behind Scarlett University
notes.content:
[h1]Voice Acting[/h1]
Some of your favorite NSFW voice actresses are bringing the heat to Scarlett University. 🔥 Each of the core 9 characters will be partially voiced (with a particular emphasis on moaning, sex noises, and dirty talk) so you can get as immersed in campus life as possible! 

Without further ado, introducing:
Main character: [url=https://x.com/_VioletVA]Violet Vampire[/url]
Raven: [url=https://x.com/_PixieWillow]Pixie Willow[/url] 
Miss Bliss: [url=https://x.com/MimiHung_VO]Mimi Hung[/url] 
Ava: [url=https://x.com/RubyRed_VA]Ruby Red[/url]
Ashley: [url=https://x.com/lheartvoiceover]Lewd Heart[/url] 
Jess: [url=https://x.com/MimiHung_VO]Mimi Hung[/url] 
Headmistress Sterling: [url=https://x.com/thevoicevixxen]The Voice Vixxen[/url] 
Sarah: Cleo Torrez
Dr. Helena: Ruda Vega

To celebrate, the demo has been updated with new voice lines and sounds that represent the final look and feel of the game! Check out a sample [url=https://x.com/BimboByte/status/1914893341294264754]here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343195/b1062149e01cdb321ed98120f85ac1e4e5c0ec9a.png[/img]
We can't wait to see you around campus. ❤️
